messages:
maria: Heads up — ap-southeast is returning ~8-12% 5xx across model-serving for the last 6m. GSLB reports available pool count down from 16 -> 4. Seeing latency tail jump too. Can we steer traffic out while we triage?

ashok: ack. pulling pool health now. @jin can you confirm GPU host restart loops? I'm seeing OOM/killed pods in ap-southeast-1 cluster.

jin: looking... kube events show kubelet eviction thrash on node gpu-a-23 -> memory pressure. pods restarting with image: redwood/infer:stable. tail of logs: "cudaOOM: mem alloc fail"

maria: that would explain KV cache pressure. For immediate mitigation, propose soft-traffic-slice: reduce ap-southeast weight to 15% then ramp over 20m. Avoid full evac to prevent cold-start storm.

ashok: agree. command to run: `gslbctl set-weight ap-southeast 15` then `gslbctl ramp --from ap-southeast --to na-west,eu-west --pct 85 --period 20m --soft`

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Executing gslbctl set-weight ap-southeast=15 -> success. Ramp job queued id=rb-20260318-01

paul: cost note: shifting 85% to na-west will increase egress/cross-region latency and unit cost ~1.4x. we should prefer EU where pricing is lower for spare capacity. Suggest split 50/35 (na/eu) instead.

maria: good point. update ramp params? `gslbctl ramp --from ap-southeast --to na-west=50,eu-west=35 --pct 85 --period 20m --soft`

jin: done. starting health checks on ap-southeast GPU nodes. if OOM persists will drain one node at a time to avoid mass eviction: `kubectl cordon` -> drain with eviction-grace 120s.

claire: I'll open a capacity ticket with provisioning: need +4 gpu hosts in ap-southeast hot standby. tagging as P2. Also adding perf/regression evals to detect if model quantization change caused memory regression.

ashok: monitoring: current pool util in ap-southeast at 92% on avg, 98% at 95th. Latency p95 increased 120ms -> 340ms. 5xx rate trending down after 10% weight reduction. keeping an eye.

maria: we should also enable KV prefix cache bypass for long histories to free memory: feature-flag ff/cache-lru-bypass=true — can we patch a config for just ap-southeast?

jin: patched configmap for ap-southeast: `cache.mode=LRU_BYPASS`, rolling restart scheduled. will do one node at a time.

paul: Cost smoothing: add a temporary soft-cap on burst routing to Dedicated pools to avoid unexpected overage. Who owns billing quota? @finance?

claire: I'll DM finance. For now we set gslb policy: `max-region-weight=70` to cap any single region from absorbing >70%

infra-bot: ramp job rb-20260318-01: 30% complete, no errors, expected finish in 14m. current weights: ap-southeast=20, na-west=45, eu-west=35

maria: :thumbsup: Good. Continue monitoring 5xx and GPU evictions. Next steps: if evictions continue -> full node replacement and rollback of recent kernel module (nvidia-driver 535.x) patch.

jin: noted. kernel rollback would require scheduled maintenance window if we need to reboot all nodes.

ashok: flagging post-incident actions: 1) capacity buffers + auto-scale policy tweak 2) alert rate threshold lowered for OOM events 3) add model-level memory regression test. I'll write the doc.

claire: opening incident doc now. tagging SRE, infra, provisioning, billing. ETA initial incident summary in 30m.

maria: thanks all. ping here with any regressions. i'll update customer success if SLAs affected.
